readonly_commands.observation: Inspected the full production and test diff.
Inspected complete Database implementation, including unchanged begin/read/publish validation.
Read tests and the legacy full-scan oracle; did not execute these tests.
No file differences between author and canonical commits.
Only the two zil-db files change production/tests; the other differences establish the research contract and baseline record.

proof_points.invariant: reverse[p] contains exactly the current published consumers with at least one dependency whose key is p.
proof_points.argument: Default and clear initialize both structures consistently. Successful publish validates before mutation, removes a replaced snapshot's old incoming edges and inserts its new incoming edges. Duplicate dependencies collapse only in the reverse set; kinds and observations remain in the snapshot. Failed publication returns before index mutation.

proof_points.invariant: Invalidation selects the same least closed set as the prior full-scan algorithm.
proof_points.argument: Initial consumers are selected only when an edge to the changed key observes a changed fingerprint of its own kind. Every consumer reachable from a lost snapshot then becomes invalid regardless of kind, matching the previous gone-dependency predicate. Index mutation occurs after traversal.

proof_points.invariant: Deletion and replacement leave no stale reverse edges.
proof_points.argument: Each removed snapshot is unlinked from every producer in its stored dependency list; empty sets are removed. All consumers of any removed producer are already in the invalidated closure. Same-result replacement updates its input edges while retaining unaffected downstream snapshots.

proof_points.invariant: Existing observable query and authorization boundaries are retained.
proof_points.argument: Read still checks the complete dependency closure and active queries. Failure/abort and revision behavior are unchanged. The invalidation return remains sorted. No front-end, verifier capability, ABI, logical-budget or backend code changes are present.

proof_points.invariant: The submitted tests address mutation maintenance as well as static DAG reachability.
proof_points.argument: Read-only inspection found coverage for input replacement with unchanged results, failed replacements, mixed/duplicate fingerprint edges, shared/deep closures, active state and clear. The pre-existing 9600-case oracle comparison now also checks exact reverse-index reconstruction. These are coverage observations, not reviewer execution results.

performance_reasoning: The baseline scans snapshots even when publish introduces an entirely new key. The indexed lookup can avoid that scan in cold CLI builds as well as in persistent sessions. Reverse-edge maintenance, cloned keys and memory remain costs; no performance outcome is asserted by this review.
limitations: No CP01 build, unit test, driver test or benchmark was executed by this reviewer during this static review.
Author and root test results are not relabeled as reviewer executions.
This is a bounded source review, not a formal proof or whole-language safety/product acceptance.
Performance integration decision remains subject to the separately frozen measurements.
